label: Parallel-fault simulation
subgoals: Reserve one bit of the word for the fault-free machine
Force each fault's bit at its site with OR and AND masks
Divide the faults by W minus 1 and round up for passes per pattern

label: Parallel-pattern single-fault simulation
subgoals: Pack W patterns into each word
Simulate the fault-free circuit and each fault once per word
Multiply the word count by faults plus one for total passes

label: Bitwise evaluation
subgoals: Map each gate to one bitwise machine instruction
Apply the instruction to the input words bit by bit
Read each output bit as one pattern's response
